items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: "You’re like Tal Farlow. He don’t practice scales, it’s true." I says that’s the difference, you can’t do that.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, yeah. Like see for one here, you know when you argue with me why do I have to know my scales, that’s why. And I can talk to you. I says like I explain that. When they argue with me, I says, “I know you don’t have to know it,” I says, “But you’re looking at a guy who happens to have everything else.” I says, “You’re like Tal Farlow. He don’t practice scales, it’s true.” I says, “But you whistle a scale and here Tal was right with you.” I says that’s the difference, you can’t do that.
Well it sounds like your students are fortunate to be working with you, I would say that.
